caption: The drawing features five kitchen utensils laid out horizontally on a plain, light beige background. Each utensil has a long, straight metal handle that is silver or gray in color, with the number "1861" inscribed in a decorative rectangular area at the end of every handle. The two utensils at the top and the two at the bottom have ladle-shaped bowls; three are circular and one is a larger, semi-circular half-bowl. These bowls are brass or gold in color; two are solid with a smooth surface, while one has numerous small holes, and another has three small holes near the center. The fourth utensil from the top is a two-pronged fork with no bowl, composed entirely of the same gray metal as the handles. The arrangement is orderly, with the utensils spaced evenly apart and oriented so that the handles point to the left and the functional ends to the right. The handles are decorated with leafy or geometric engravings. The overall color scheme consists of metallic grays and golds against an unembellished background.
title: Kitchen Utensils
